title: Real cubic torsion authority
objective: Implement and replay exact torsion authority for the authentic real cubic h=1 sentinel from prepared neutral field data, including maximality and mutation tests

oracles: Exact cubic discriminant, rational-root irreducibility, and multiplication-table replay
PARI 2.17.4 nfrootsof1 on the pinned sentinel

handoff.summary: Added a standalone exact roots-of-unity authority for the authentic totally real cubic sentinel. It consumes only the prepared defining polynomial, proves cubic irreducibility and three real embeddings, verifies -1 has exact order two and norm -1 in the quotient algebra, proves maximality through an injective real embedding, and seals all claims behind field-pinned detached replay. The focused checker rejects coordinated rehashed mutations and agrees with private PARI 2.17.4 nfrootsof1=[2,-1].
risks: This intentionally narrow authority covers irreducible monic totally real cubics; non-real fields need the general cyclotomic/root-of-unity path.
The full test:changed run was stopped during its broad repository build at integration-owner request; focused syntax, Ruff format, contract, mutation, and private-PARI checks pass.
next_steps: Integrate the returned torsion record into the authentic final result without weakening the separate unit, regulator, relation, or public-completeness gates.
